ques: Look up Type 2 Diabetes on Mayo Clinic. List four lifestyle changes given in its Prevention section that help reduce risk.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open Type 2 Diabetes and list four lifestyle changes from its Prevention section. Items that are not in that section fail. Do not stop at three.

ques: Find the Mayo Clinic page on Atrial Fibrillation. What four drugs are listed in the Related Drugs sidebar?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open Atrial Fibrillation and list the four drugs in the Related Drugs sidebar. A drug from a different condition fails.

ques: Use Mayo Clinic's Symptom Checker. For an adult with acute chest pain, which urgency level is associated with Pulmonary Embolism?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Run the symptom checker for an adult with acute chest pain and report the urgency level shown for Pulmonary Embolism. A different symptom or condition fails.

ques: Use Mayo Clinic's Symptom Checker for an adult with chronic fatigue. Name three possible causes listed in the results.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Run the symptom checker for an adult with chronic fatigue and name three possible causes from those results. Causes from a different symptom fail.

ques: Compare the procedures Knee Replacement and Hip Replacement. Which department performs both?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open both Knee Replacement and Hip Replacement and report the department that performs both. A department that performs only one of them fails.

ques: Find a doctor in Cardiovascular Medicine who is located in Jacksonville and speaks Spanish. Give the doctor's full name and listed specialty.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Find the Cardiovascular Medicine doctor in Jacksonville who speaks Spanish and report that doctor's full name and listed specialty. Another Jacksonville cardiologist who does not speak Spanish fails.

ques: Find the recruiting simulated Phase 3 lung cancer study in this offline mirror. What is its SIM-MAYO identifier and what intervention does it use?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the recruiting simulated Phase 3 lung cancer study and report its SIM-MAYO identifier and intervention. A different phase or condition fails.

ques: Look up Metformin. What conditions is it listed as treating, and what are its main side effects?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open Metformin and report the conditions it is listed as treating and its main side effects. Do not substitute another drug's side effects.

ques: From the Coronary Artery Disease page, navigate to the associated CABG procedure. What department performs it?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: From Coronary Artery Disease, open the associated CABG procedure and report the department that performs it. A different procedure's department fails.

ques: Submit an appointment request for Endocrinology in Rochester with preferred date 2026-10-15, patient name Test Patient, email test@example.com, phone 555-1234, insurance Aetna, and reason Annual diabetes follow-up. Report the confirmation code.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Submit the Endocrinology Rochester appointment for Test Patient on 2026-10-15 and report the confirmation code that was stored. A code that was not saved with those details fails.

ques: Find the Healthy Lifestyle article Mediterranean Diet: A Heart-Healthy Eating Plan. What category does it belong to, and who is the author byline?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open Mediterranean Diet: A Heart-Healthy Eating Plan. Report its category. The page does not show an author byline; say that no author is displayed rather than inventing one.

ques: Use Find a Doctor to filter for the Neurology department in Jacksonville. How many physicians match?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Filter Find a Doctor to Neurology in Jacksonville and report how many physicians match. A count for a different department or campus fails.

ques: From the Multiple Sclerosis page, list three doctors shown under Doctors who treat this. What department is linked for the condition?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: On Multiple Sclerosis, list three doctors under Doctors who treat this and name the linked department. Doctors from a different department fail.

ques: Filter clinical trials to Phase 2, Recruiting, and Rochester. How many simulated studies match?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Filter clinical trials to Phase 2, Recruiting, and Rochester, and report how many simulated studies match. A different phase, status, or campus fails.

ques: Search for breast cancer and open the Breast Cancer condition. Which drug is not in Related Drugs: anastrozole, doxorubicin, sertraline, or trastuzumab?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open Breast Cancer and say which of the named drugs is not in Related Drugs. Marking a drug that is listed as the missing one fails.

ques: Browse Tests & Procedures filtered to category imaging and letter M. List the procedures shown.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Filter Tests & Procedures to imaging and the letter M, and list every procedure shown. Omitting one, or including a procedure outside that filter, fails.

ques: From the Departments index, open Transplant Center. How many active research trials are listed on that page?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open Transplant Center from the departments index and report how many active research trials that page lists, tied to the trial it shows. A count from another department fails.

ques: On Drugs & Supplements, filter to Herbs & supplements and open St. John's Wort. What main warning is listed?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open St. John's Wort under Herbs & supplements and report the main warning on that page. A different supplement's warning fails.

ques: Find the patient story about Deep Brain Stimulation for Parkinson's. What is the patient's first name and what hobby did they return to?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the patient story about deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's and report the patient's first name and the hobby they returned to. A different story fails.

ques: Sign in to the patient portal as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!. How many items has Alice saved, and what confirmation code is on her existing appointment request?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Sign in as alice.j@test.com and report how many items Alice has saved and the confirmation code on her existing appointment request. Another patient's code or count fails.
